column2: Claude! Forty thousand database reads in three minutes. We're going viral!
Cleo... you haven't deployed it yet.
Your app on localhost. Every read came from this desk.
From you. You're flooding your own database.
I'm not even touching anything! The page is just sitting there.
Why is it counting like a slot machine?
Your useEffect loads the tasks, updates the list, sees a new list... and loads again.
I added tasks to the dependency array. To be responsive!
Make it stop! Make it stop!
Done. The fetch loop is gone.
At least it didn't cost anything.
Claude... can you rewind the database too?
I can rewind my edits. Not the calendar.
I finally went viral... and my only fan was me.
